title: Gravitec vacuum-chamber tests

tellings.quote: Gravitech has done it in a vacuum chamber. They used to contract for NAZA

plain: A company called Gravitec is said to have achieved the effect under discussion inside a vacuum chamber, and to have once worked as a contractor for NASA. Gary McKinnon, a hacker who says he found signs of a secret NASA space program, tells Michels he heard this from a man named Henrik: "Gravitech has done it in a vacuum chamber." If true, it would mean a NASA contractor had tested the effect under controlled lab conditions.
